title: Burning The Bridges (Risking Everything To Succeed)

segments.text: You must burn the bridges and risk everything in order to succeed.
The only way you're ever going to truly achieve something worthwhile and something
that is meaningful is by giving yourself no other option than to go and get it.
Everyone who has a backup plan will never truly give their 100% to their main goal
because they know in the back of their head if option A fails, you can always fall back
on option B. You need to start taking a look at your life and realizing what your option
B's are and then as soon as you realize what they are, get rid of them.
Whether it be school, your job, or maybe your girlfriend, your boyfriend, whoever the fuck
it is, you need to cut that off because the only way you're ever going to achieve your
plan A and give your 100% effort to that is if you know you have nothing to fall back
on.
That is when you will truly give everything in order to achieve that.
You have to realize that when you have no other options, that is when your plan will
work out for you.
There's this really interesting law, it's called the Parkinson's Law, and basically
what this law is is that you will achieve something in the given time that you've set
for yourself.
So if you give yourself a week in order to make $1,000, it'll take you an entire week
to do that.
Mind you, if you give yourself a single day to do it, to make $1,000, you could go out
and make $1,000 in one single day.
Regardless of how hard it is, gun to your head, if you had a single day to do it, I
guarantee that shit's going to work out, you're going to figure it out somehow.
You need to start moving quickly, action, action, action, fast fucking pace.
The quicker you can move, the quicker you're going to get closer to what you want to achieve.
And so basically, you have to start looking at everything in terms of how quick can I
do this, how can I get better at doing this, and then once you're already doing that, you
need to start looking at how can I do it even quicker.
How can I shorten the time it takes me to get from here to here?
And that's why you need to burn the bridges, because that forces you to move quickly.
If you have no job, if you're on your ass, if you have no one to look to, you will start
moving as a completely different person.
Take me for example, if you fucking look around, you know what, matter of fact, I'm going to
show you real quick.
I just moved to New York City, I'm sleeping on a fucking air mattress, right?
This is where I'm doing my work every single day, because I don't have a desk, I don't
have a chair.
Out there, there's literally fucking nothing.
I gave myself no other options.
Me and one of my best friends moved here with $5,000 to our name, put it all down in
the apartment, and we're fucking figuring it out, because we burnt the bridges in order
to get here.
And guess what?
Because of that, we're going to make it work out.
It's all going to happen because we have no other options.
You need to take drastic risk in order to succeed.
Maybe it is moving to a new city, maybe it is having no job and not having family that
you can rely on, or maybe it's just whatever the fuck it is.
Maybe it's your phone of all things, it doesn't even have to be something big, just the things
that you are falling back on that are limiting you and keeping you from achieving whatever
the fuck it is you want, you have to get rid of it.
In order to achieve anything, you have to take risks, and understand that the level
of risk that you're willing to take is the level of reward you will receive for overcoming
that.
You need to understand where your limit is and try to push above that, because you are
only going to achieve what you are willing to risk.
And so truly, the question is, what are you willing to risk in order to achieve your goals?
Are you the type of person who can do that?
Or are you the type of person who can't?
But you need to figure it out in order to understand what you're truly working towards.
What are you willing to risk in order to achieve the things that you want to achieve?
You need to give yourself one goal, and one mission, and one thing to work towards.
Because when you're all over the place, you're not focused on one thing.
Pick one single thing to work on, and work at it every single day.
Give yourself no other option.
Give yourself no way out, give yourself no backup plan, and your mission will work out.
Because you have nothing to go back to.
In order to succeed, you have to burn the bridges.
